data.exact_reserve_text: The 2013 underwriting year result improved by GBP 1.3m as a result of a reduction in prior years' reserves for a number of catastrophe losses.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 557 reported a modest release of prior year reserves relating to the 2013 underwriting year. The managing agent cites a GBP 1.3m improvement driven by reductions in prior-years reserves following favourable development on a number of catastrophe losses. The movement is a release and primarily attributable to favourable claims development on catastrophe-exposed business.
raw_causal_phrases: reduction in prior years' reserves for a number of catastrophe losses
result improved by GBP 1.3m as a result of a reduction in prior years' reserves
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure sourced from underwriter's narrative stating a GBP 1.3m improvement on the 2013 underwriting year. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line with a gross figure was located for Syndicate 557; the narrative amount may be net of reinsurance or refer specifically to the closed year result. Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative (2014) column. A gross claims development triangle for Syndicate 557 was present but the report did not present an explicit gross PY movement line; narrative used with moderate confidence.
